headline.zh: 前滩太古里艺术风咖啡
headline.en: Art Deco style café in Qiantan

traits.zh: 店内少量桌椅，外有遮阳伞户外座
traits.en: Few indoor tables and outdoor seating with umbrellas

traits.zh: 使用SCA杯测84分以上单一产地豆，季更
traits.en: Single-origin beans, SCA 84+ points, seasonal rotation

traits.zh: 招牌饮品含罗马人美式、咸奶萃、白脱拿铁
traits.en: Featured drinks include Roman Espresso, salty milk extract, butter latte

traits.zh: 临街落地窗设计，采光良好
traits.en: Large floor-to-ceiling windows with good natural light

focus.en: Suitable for working, seen users with laptops

linger.zh: 有室内外座位，适合停留
linger.en: Has seating inside and out, allows lingering

energy.zh: 非深夜营业，商圈常规时段
